name: Employment Subsidy Scheme, 2017
benefit:
- Reimbursement shall be restricted to ₹7,000/- per Goan employee per month.
- The total subsidy for Micro, Small, Medium enterprises and eco-tourism projects shall not exceed ₹25,00,000/- per annum, on a pro rata basis depending on the date of production.
- The total subsidy for Large enterprises shall not exceed ₹50,00,000/- per annum, on a pro rata basis depending on the date of production.
- S
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be classified as a Micro, Small, Medium, or Large manufacturing industry. - The applicant must be listed under the white category, green category, or orange category. - The applicant must engage a minimum of 60% of Goan manpower on regular employment. - The applicant must ensure the employees counted for the percentage calculation are employed on the enterprise’s payroll continuously during the claim year. - The applicant must ensure the Goan employees considered for subsidy calculation are up to 60 years of age. - The applicant must ensure the Goan employees considered for subsidy calculation are paid a gross salary of more than ₹8,000/- per month. - The applicant must ensure that the relations defined under section 56 of the Income Tax Act, 1961, are not counted as employees for the purpose of this scheme. - The applicant must not have availed of the Chief Minister’s Rojgar Yojana (CMRY) Scheme or any other employment generation scheme of the Government of India or the Government of Goa. - The applicant must not be taking or have taken any benefit under any policy of the Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa. - The applicant must not have claimed similar benefit under any other scheme/program of the Government of Goa. - The applicant must submit the application for at least one claim to the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC) during the scheme's validity (up to September 30, 2022). ##### ***Eligibility for Hinterland Eco-Tourism Projects*** - The applicant must be a project of Hinterland Eco tourism in lesser developed talukas. - The applicant must be registered with/recognised by the Department of Tourism/Goa Investment Promotion Board (IPB)/Town & Country Planning/Planning & Development Authority (PDA)/Eco Sensitive Zone Authority.
